transport.title: Transport & Pilgrim Logistics
transport.description: Traveler guidance by scenario: arriving by car, train, bus, or walking between ghats.
transport.splitDescription: The Kumbh Mela takes place at two main centers separated by ~28 km along NH848: Nashik City (Godavari Ramkund) and Trimbakeshwar (Jyotirlinga & Kushavarta Kund). Shuttle buses connect outer parking zones to both locations.
transport.unverifiedNotice: [PLACEHOLDER — verify with official source] Specific timetables, fares, and shuttle frequencies will be updated when MSRTC and Railway Mela schedules are released.

about.title: About Yatriva
about.subtitle: Independent Kumbh Mela Visitor Guide
about.missionText: Yatriva is created to provide accessible, multi-lingual, and reliable guidance for millions of pilgrims visiting the Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Simhastha Kumbh Mela 2027.
about.dataText: We strictly adhere to data integrity rules. Unverified coordinates, timings, and contact numbers are clearly tagged with PLACEHOLDER badges until officially verified.
about.offlineText: Designed to function under heavy network congestion with PWA support and local caching.
